tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description: List cities covered by the Permit Intelligence API, with pricing and payment details. Free. Full paid feeds for humans: https://permitverdict.com/pricing

tools.name: check_permit_activity
tools.description: FREE. Quick check on whether a street address has building-permit activity on record: how many permits, how many are open, and when the last activity was. No permit detail and no verdict — use get_permit_verdict for those. Full paid feeds for humans: https://permitverdict.com/pricing

tools.name: find_active_projects
tools.description: FREE PREVIEW (5 results). Recently permitted construction projects in a covered city, filtered by declared budget. Use feed='investor' instead to surface expired and abandoned permits (stalled projects, often motivated owners). Full paid feeds for humans: https://permitverdict.com/pricing

tools.name: list_settlement_assets
tools.description: FREE. Which crypto assets, venues, operators and modes the settlement oracle supports, plus pricing. Full paid feeds for humans: https://permitverdict.com/pricing

tools.name: resolve_price_event
tools.description: Settlement verdict for a crypto price event. Answers 'did this asset trade or close above/below a threshold during a window?' with YES/NO/DISPUTED/UNRESOLVED, per-venue evidence from Hyperliquid, Coinbase and Kraken, and stated confidence. tools.name: get_crypto_spot
tools.description: Live cross-venue spot price with venue agreement and spread. A wide spread means venues disagree and any settlement in that range is contestable. Paid: $0.01 in USDC via x402.

tools.name: decode_decision_id
tools.description: FREE. Read what a Permit Verdict decision_id claims and check whether we actually issued it. The id is signed by the same wallet that receives payment, so forgery and after-the-fact editing are both detectable. Needs no payment. This tells you the record is genuine; it does NOT tell you the verdict

tools.name: verify_decision
tools.description: Re-resolve an attested settlement against the price venues right now and report whether it still holds: CONFIRMED, CHANGED or INDETERMINATE. tools.name: attest_price_event
tools.description: Settlement verdict plus a citable record: a signed decision_id, an integrity hash over the evidence, and every candle that determined the outcome. tools.name: get_permit_verdict
tools.description: Address-level building-permit intelligence for a covered city: normalized permit history + activity signals + a decision-ready verdict with cited public records. Paid: $2.00 in USDC on base via x402.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "resolve_price_event" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
